quote: (f) Credit Support Document. ... is a "Credit Support Document": In relation to Party B, the Credit Agreement, and the Security Documents, or the Collateral Documents, as the case may be, as defined in the Credit Agreement.
correct_answer: No; credit support is provided through the Credit Agreement and its Security/Collateral Documents, not a Credit Support Annex
reason: The only Credit Support Documents are the Credit Agreement and its security documents, and no Credit Support Annex is referenced, so "no" is correct and "yes" is wrong.
